'invalid referer host' unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`. `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` delegates to `record_for_host(...).present?`, which will be false when the `embeddable_hosts` table is empty, causing the same `'invalid referer host'` error for both (a) no hosts configured and (b) referer not allowed.
